name: Original Image Set Filenames
changes: Restore the original browser filename when SABnzbd assigns its own NewzDeck Loose <token> staging basename to a completed image.
Protect existing downloads with collision-safe numbered names and require a matching exact staging token, one known expected filename, and the same image extension.
Keep Completed display name aligned with the actual saved single image filename after flattening.
regression_guards: Do not rename actual decoded filenames, unknown or opaque names, other jobs, non-images, or multi-file packages.
Preserve v3.7.16 silent video helpers, v3.7.15 media filtering and queue grouping, v3.7.14 Completed Remove All, and v3.7.13 preview recovery.
Keep SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3, NNTP, PAR2, Smart Import, user configuration, and install/update lifecycle unchanged.
preserved: Existing downloaded files are not scanned or renamed retroactively; filename restoration applies as new jobs complete.
